sourceNotes: 新增标准与手绘 Dock 图标切换，选择在重启后保留，并同步到访达与聚焦搜索使用的系统应用图标
主界面新增 X 关注入口
更新 XStats 与 Capture 品牌图标
主程序图标设置移至「菜单栏 → 高级」

en: Switch between standard and hand-drawn Dock icons, preserve the choice across restarts, and synchronize the system app icon used by Finder and Spotlight.
Add a Follow on X entry to the main interface.
Refresh the XStats and Capture icons with consistent near-white rounded backplates, visual size, and spacing, while retaining transparent branding assets (#20).
Move the main app's icon setting to Menu Bar → Advanced. Icon-only mode can automatically follow the menu bar, while separate-item and combined modes offer standard or hand-drawn styles.
